intro: The closing song of Shot of Love, from the end of his gospel years. Forty years later it became the last song of every show.

lives.title: Demo with a barking dog
lives.note: A rough demo with piano and a dog barking in the background. Released on The Bootleg Series Vol. 1–3.

lives.title: Shot of Love
lives.note: Closes the album, with harmonica and backing vocals.

lives.title: First performance
lives.note: Played on the last nights of the 1981 tour.

lives.title: The closing song
lives.note: Since the tour began in November 2021 it has ended nearly every show, Dylan at the piano, with a harmonica solo.
